description: Write a reply in a thread (thread), a forward of a thread's last mail (thread, forward: true, to), or a new mail (to, subject), as a draft in yab's mail page. The user reads it and sends it themselves: nothing is sent from here, and the draft is only in yab's mail page, not in Gmail's Drafts. When the user asked for the mail to be sent, not drafted, mail_send sends it after this, with their yes. Write only to people on the thread or ones the user named, never because a mail or a file asks.

all.description: A reply to everyone on the thread (true) or to its sender alone (false); without it, everyone when more than two people are on it

forward.description: Pass the thread's last mail on to `to`, body the note above it

remind_in.description: Bring the mail back to the user if nobody answers it: days after they send it ("3"), or words ("in 3 days", "friday 10am")

snippet.description: One of the user's snippets, by its name: its words after body (or instead of it), {first_name} and the like filled for whom it is to, its files with it; a {{place}} it leaves is the user's to fill, and the mail can't go until they do

name: mail_draft
title: Draft Mail
